items.title: GenPage: Towards End-to-End Generative Homepage Construction at Netflix
items.summary: Netflix 将首页从行级推荐推进到端到端生成式页面构建：模型结合长期偏好、分页上下文和实时会话反馈逐步生成下一组推荐，适合观察大规模推荐从候选排序走向页面级决策的系统边界。

interpretation.businessProblem: Netflix 首页不只是给一行内容排序，而是要在整个首屏/分页层面同时决定行类型、行内实体、观看意图、多样性和长期满意度；传统“逐行候选 + 局部排序”很难优化页面整体体验。
interpretation.systemMechanism: 把用户历史、画像、请求上下文和结构化 homepage layout token 化为同一序列，由生成式 transformer 直接生成页面结构；再用强化学习后训练把离线行为目标和页面多样性校准到上线策略。
interpretation.metricsAndExperiment: 离线看页面级 engagement 代理指标、行/实体多样性、序列有效性和 cold-start 表现；线上必须同时看播放转化、浏览深度、长期留存、重复曝光和 P95 生成延迟。
interpretation.borrowable: 适合借鉴“页面即序列”的建模方式：先把推荐结果、广告位、运营位统一成可验证 layout token，再用小流量 shadow serving 对比传统漏斗。
interpretation.boundary: 如果业务页面结构简单、样本量不足或运营规则强依赖人工编排，端到端生成会让解释、干预和回滚成本明显上升。

items.title: SilverTorch: Index as Model — A New Retrieval Paradigm for Recommendation Systems
items.summary: Meta 将推荐检索组件统一到 index-as-model 架构，报告相比既有方案最高 23.7x 吞吐、20.9x 计算成本效率提升，并强调准确率、GPU serving 和 UGC 召回的一体化权衡。

interpretation.businessProblem: UGC 推荐的召回阶段要在毫秒级从海量内容缩到千级候选，传统微服务、ANN 索引和神经模型分散部署会造成准确率、吞吐和运维边界彼此牵制。
interpretation.systemMechanism: Meta 将检索索引本身模型化，把 candidate generation、embedding 表征、GPU serving 和 ranker 对齐放进统一架构，让检索结果直接服务后续排序目标。
interpretation.metricsAndExperiment: 关注吞吐、单位请求计算成本、recall/precision、候选新鲜度、P95/P99 延迟、GPU 利用率和线上 CTR/停留转化；离线召回提升必须能解释到 ranker 输入质量。
interpretation.borrowable: 中大型推荐团队可先做一条垂直召回路的 index-as-model 旁路，把原 ANN/规则召回与模型化召回做 interleaving 或 shadow 对比。
interpretation.boundary: 内容规模小、GPU serving 能力不足、召回和排序 owner 分裂时，不宜直接复制整套架构；先解决特征/样本/评测对齐。

items.title: Unlocking dependable responses with Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform's Agentic RAG
items.summary: Google Research 与 Google Cloud 将企业 RAG 改造成多 Agent 检索工作流，用 sufficient context agent 反复补齐证据后再回答，面向跨语料、多跳企业搜索。

interpretation.businessProblem: 企业 RAG 常见失败不是模型不会回答，而是权限文档、跨系统证据和长尾查询没有被充分检索，导致答案看似完整但依据不足。
interpretation.systemMechanism: Google 的 Agentic RAG 把检索拆成多步 agent 流程，由 sufficient-context 判断是否需要继续检索、改写查询或补充证据，再进入回答生成。
interpretation.metricsAndExperiment: 应同时评估 answer groundedness、证据覆盖率、权限误召、二次检索次数、用户追问率、P95 延迟和每答案检索成本。
interpretation.borrowable: 企业知识库可把“证据是否足够”做成独立 judge，在高风险答案前触发补检索和人工复核，而不是只调大 topK。
interpretation.boundary: 权限模型不清、审计日志不完整或知识库质量差时，多 Agent 检索会放大错误证据和延迟。

items.title: Meta Adaptive Ranking Model: Bending the Inference Scaling Curve to Serve LLM-Scale Models for Ads
items.summary: Meta 讨论在实时广告推荐中服务 LLM-scale 排序模型的复杂度/效率矛盾，核心是让模型容量、延迟预算和广告业务目标共同优化。

interpretation.businessProblem: 广告排序想引入更大模型理解用户意图和广告价值，但广告请求要求亚秒级返回，且算力成本必须被 ROAS 覆盖。
interpretation.systemMechanism: Meta 用 request-centric routing、硬件感知模型/系统协同和多卡 serving，让不同请求按价值、上下文和延迟预算选择合适模型复杂度。
interpretation.metricsAndExperiment: 线上核心看 ad conversions、CTR、广告主价值、用户负反馈、P95/P99 延迟、MFU、单位转化推理成本和预算消耗稳定性。
interpretation.borrowable: 广告团队可先把“请求价值分层 + 模型复杂度路由”用于高商业价值流量，低价值请求继续走轻模型，逐步验证边际 ROI。
interpretation.boundary: 若转化回传慢、归因链路弱或缺少请求级成本核算，大模型排序的收益很容易被平均成本吞掉。

items.title: Reel Friends: Building Social Discovery that Scales to Billions
items.summary: Meta 介绍 Reels 社交发现系统如何在十亿级规模下把好友关系、内容理解、召回和排序结合，说明推荐链路正在从纯兴趣匹配扩展到社交图谱驱动的发现机制。

interpretation.businessProblem: 短视频发现不只靠兴趣相似，还要把好友关系、互动意图和内容消费场景纳入推荐，否则社交分发与纯兴趣分发会互相稀释。

items.title: From Clicks to Conversions: Architecting Shopping Conversion Candidate Generation at Pinterest
items.summary: Pinterest 介绍购物转化候选生成模型，从点击信号转向转化目标，并讨论大规模上线到 6 亿月活用户的系统设计。

interpretation.businessProblem: 购物推荐如果只优化点击，会把流量导向好奇心内容而非购买意图；候选生成阶段必须更早感知转化概率和商品可购性。

interpretation.boundary: 转化样本稀疏、商品库存/价格不稳定或归因窗口很长时，转化候选容易过拟合头部商家和短期促销。

items.title: Enhancing Ad Relevance: Integrating Real-Time Context into Sequential Recommender Models
items.summary: Pinterest 将实时浏览上下文接入广告序列召回，通过 synthetic context 训练和离线/在线混合用户 embedding 推理，在 Related Pins 场景提升 Recall@K、候选相关性和广告 relevance。

interpretation.businessProblem: Pinterest Related Pins 广告既要利用用户长期 offsite 转化序列，又要响应当前浏览 Pin 的实时语义；只用静态用户 embedding 会错过会话意图。
interpretation.systemMechanism: 在 Transformer 用户塔之外增加 context layer，将当前 Pin 的兴趣类别 embedding、置信权重和用户人口统计特征拼接进最终 MLP；训练时用正样本构造 synthetic context，serving 时采用离线序列 embedding + 在线 context head 的混合推理。
interpretation.metricsAndExperiment: 离线用 Recall@K 衡量正样本进入 topK 的能力，线上看 candidate survival、relevance、广告相关性、delivery 和业务指标；文章报告 Recall@K 提升 3x-10x，候选相关性中位数提升约 275%-300%，Related Pins ads relevance 提升 1.08%。
interpretation.borrowable: 广告召回可把“长期用户序列”和“实时上下文”拆成离线/在线两段推理，既控制延迟又让当前页面语义影响召回 embedding。
interpretation.boundary: 当实时上下文质量不稳、训练无法构造可信 synthetic context，或在线 head 延迟预算太紧时，这种混合推理会引入线上线下偏差。

items.title: Why We Use Separate Tech Stacks for Personalization and Experimentation
items.summary: Spotify 解释为什么把个性化 ML 栈和实验平台分离：ML 栈负责低延迟推荐决策，实验栈负责评估、rollout 和跨团队治理，避免 contextual bandit 被误用成万能平台。

interpretation.businessProblem: 个性化推荐和实验平台都处理用户差异，但目标不同：前者要实时做个体决策，后者要可靠判断策略是否带来长期收益；混成一套系统会让特征、延迟、指标窗口和治理互相牵制。
interpretation.systemMechanism: Spotify 让 ML/AI 栈承载推荐模型、特征和低延迟 serving，把 contextual bandit 等个性化策略作为实验 variant 接入 Confidence 实验平台，由实验栈负责随机化、rollout、统计评估和多团队并行。
interpretation.metricsAndExperiment: 核心看长期留存、收听行为、首页实验吞吐、模型迭代速度、实验配置错误、低延迟特征稳定性；文中给出移动首页一年 58 个团队运行 520 个实验的治理量级。
interpretation.borrowable: 中大型推荐团队应把“模型服务”和“实验判定”拆成两个 owner 清晰的系统；bandit 可以是策略，不应替代实验平台、特征平台和长期指标观测。
interpretation.boundary: 早期产品样本少、指标窗口短或没有实验文化时，完整双栈会显得重；但至少要避免把线上自适应流量分配误当成长期因果结论。

items.title: How we optimized Dash's relevance judge with DSPy
items.summary: Dropbox Dash 用 DSPy 将 relevance judge 从手写 prompt 调参变成可度量优化循环，在 query-document 相关性评分上降低 NMSE，并显著减少结构化输出失败。

interpretation.businessProblem: 企业搜索需要大量 query-document 相关性标签来训练排序模型，但人工标注成本高，LLM judge 又容易贵、漂移和输出格式不稳定。
interpretation.systemMechanism: 把 relevance judge 固定为 1-5 分 JSON 输出任务，使用带解释的人类标注样本和 NMSE 作为目标，再用 DSPy/GEPA 自动搜索 prompt，使低成本模型贴近人工评分并保持可解析输出。
interpretation.metricsAndExperiment: 指标包括 NMSE、人类一致性、有效 JSON 比例、模型成本、批处理失败率和迁移到小模型后的回归；文章报告 o3 到 gpt-oss-120b 适配 NMSE 降低 45%，gemma-3-12b malformed JSON 下降超过 97%。
interpretation.borrowable: 搜索/推荐团队可把 LLM judge 当作可优化的生产组件：固定任务 schema、准备人工金标、把输出合法性纳入损失，而不是只做主观 prompt review。
interpretation.boundary: LLM judge 不能替代最终线上 A/B；敏感数据、权限文档、长尾 query 和跨语言语义仍需人工抽检与漂移监控。

items.title: Our Multi-Agent Architecture for Smarter Advertising

items.title: SABER-Math: Automated Benchmark for Information Retrieval Evaluation in Mathematics
items.summary: As agentic AI systems tackle more complex mathematical tasks, they increasingly rely on information retrieval (IR) to search problem databases, theorem libraries, and educational resources. However, choosing the right retriever remains difficult, as it is infeasible to directly isolate its effect on downstream performance. On the other hand, existing retrieval-specific benchmarks often fail to capture fine-grained mathematical relevance, penalizing relevant documents. We address this gap by introducing SABER-Math, the first fully automated benchmark for evaluating mathematical IR without expert annotation. Starting from 283K high-school-level math problems with solutions, SABER-Math builds challenging reranking tasks in three steps: (i) first, LLMs extract concise solution summaries and mathematical topics for each problem; (ii) then, per-query relevant documents are discovered using ontology topic-based and lexical solutions-summary-based similarities, and (iii) finally, a Swiss-style LLM preference tournament produces fine-grained relevance ratings for the documents. We evaluate lexical retrievers, specialized mathematical retrieval systems, and recent embedding models. We find that while modern embedding models substantially outperform classical and math-specific baselines, even the strongest systems struggle in symbol-heavy domains like Algebra and Calculus. Importantly, we show that general-purpose IR benchmarks such as MTEB do not reliably predict mathematical performance, especially for recent embedding models, highlighting the need for math-specific retrieval benchmarks.

items.title: Fast and Feasible: Permutation-based Constrained Reranking for Revenue Maximization
items.summary: Search and recommender systems have produced highly relevant search results. A natural next step in the development of such systems in e-commerce is to rerank these results to increase the platform's revenue from paid promotion products. However, maximizing revenue alone may degrade the user experience by reducing relevance or increasing fraud risk. To avoid this, we state the reranking problem as an integer linear program ($ILP$) that maximizes revenue subject to per-query constraints on other metrics, e.g., relevance. Since solving $ILP$ exactly for every query is slow for deployment to the online service, we propose a lightweight permutation-based reranking approximation algorithm PermR. At each step, the algorithm selects a pair of neighboring items and swaps them to either improve the objective or repair a violated constraint. We evaluate PermR across multiple categories of a large classified platform in offline and online settings. PermR achieves about 63\% of the ILP revenue improvement, within production latency limits, preserving all constraints. In a 14-day online A/B test over 56 million search queries, PermR increased revenue by $2$\%.

items.title: Planning over Matrix-Factorization MDPs for Candidate Generation
items.summary: For a recommender service, we view the customer journey as a chain of item recommendations: a useful item changes the user's state and therefore what should be retrieved next. Standard matrix-factorization retrieval ignores this -- it builds one user vector and returns the top-$K$ items by a static score, treating them as independent. We ask a narrow question: when is it worth planning over the user-state dynamics that fold-in induces? To answer it we propose casting top-$K$ retrieval as an MDP over the implicit-ALS posterior $(A^{-1},u)$, where an action is an item and the transition is a closed-form rank-one fold-in, and the trajectory reward combines a relevance similarity with a posterior-alignment term. Under the same fixed embeddings we compare static retrieval, one-step planning, and horizon-$K$ MCTS across five datasets and two protocols: a per-user leave-last-$n$ split and a stricter global time split. Dynamics-aware planning tends to overcome static retrieval on all datasets under leave-last-$n$, and the gains hold on MovieLens-1M and the VK-LSVD slices under the global time split. A single step of lookahead already captures most of the gain, so the lightweight planning layer turns static top-$K$ scoring into a short decision and improves retrieval over fixed collaborative-filtering embeddings, with no retraining and no change to the representation. These gains depend on measuring relevance with cosine rather than inner-product similarity, which is otherwise entangled with item popularity.

items.title: GenPage: Towards End-to-End Generative Homepage Construction at Netflix
items.summary: Netflix 将首页从行级推荐推进到端到端生成式页面构建：模型结合长期偏好、分页上下文和实时会话反馈逐步生成下一组推荐，适合观察大规模推荐从候选排序走向页面级决策的系统边界。

interpretation.businessProblem: Netflix 首页不只是给一行内容排序，而是要在整个首屏/分页层面同时决定行类型、行内实体、观看意图、多样性和长期满意度；传统“逐行候选 + 局部排序”很难优化页面整体体验。
interpretation.systemMechanism: 把用户历史、画像、请求上下文和结构化 homepage layout token 化为同一序列，由生成式 transformer 直接生成页面结构；再用强化学习后训练把离线行为目标和页面多样性校准到上线策略。
interpretation.metricsAndExperiment: 离线看页面级 engagement 代理指标、行/实体多样性、序列有效性和 cold-start 表现；线上必须同时看播放转化、浏览深度、长期留存、重复曝光和 P95 生成延迟。
interpretation.borrowable: 适合借鉴“页面即序列”的建模方式：先把推荐结果、广告位、运营位统一成可验证 layout token，再用小流量 shadow serving 对比传统漏斗。
interpretation.boundary: 如果业务页面结构简单、样本量不足或运营规则强依赖人工编排，端到端生成会让解释、干预和回滚成本明显上升。

items.title: SilverTorch: Index as Model — A New Retrieval Paradigm for Recommendation Systems
items.summary: Meta 将推荐检索组件统一到 index-as-model 架构，报告相比既有方案最高 23.7x 吞吐、20.9x 计算成本效率提升，并强调准确率、GPU serving 和 UGC 召回的一体化权衡。

interpretation.businessProblem: UGC 推荐的召回阶段要在毫秒级从海量内容缩到千级候选，传统微服务、ANN 索引和神经模型分散部署会造成准确率、吞吐和运维边界彼此牵制。
interpretation.systemMechanism: Meta 将检索索引本身模型化，把 candidate generation、embedding 表征、GPU serving 和 ranker 对齐放进统一架构，让检索结果直接服务后续排序目标。
interpretation.metricsAndExperiment: 关注吞吐、单位请求计算成本、recall/precision、候选新鲜度、P95/P99 延迟、GPU 利用率和线上 CTR/停留转化；离线召回提升必须能解释到 ranker 输入质量。
interpretation.borrowable: 中大型推荐团队可先做一条垂直召回路的 index-as-model 旁路，把原 ANN/规则召回与模型化召回做 interleaving 或 shadow 对比。
interpretation.boundary: 内容规模小、GPU serving 能力不足、召回和排序 owner 分裂时，不宜直接复制整套架构；先解决特征/样本/评测对齐。

items.title: Unlocking dependable responses with Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform's Agentic RAG
items.summary: Google Research 与 Google Cloud 将企业 RAG 改造成多 Agent 检索工作流，用 sufficient context agent 反复补齐证据后再回答，面向跨语料、多跳企业搜索。

interpretation.businessProblem: 企业 RAG 常见失败不是模型不会回答，而是权限文档、跨系统证据和长尾查询没有被充分检索，导致答案看似完整但依据不足。
interpretation.systemMechanism: Google 的 Agentic RAG 把检索拆成多步 agent 流程，由 sufficient-context 判断是否需要继续检索、改写查询或补充证据，再进入回答生成。
interpretation.metricsAndExperiment: 应同时评估 answer groundedness、证据覆盖率、权限误召、二次检索次数、用户追问率、P95 延迟和每答案检索成本。
interpretation.borrowable: 企业知识库可把“证据是否足够”做成独立 judge，在高风险答案前触发补检索和人工复核，而不是只调大 topK。
interpretation.boundary: 权限模型不清、审计日志不完整或知识库质量差时，多 Agent 检索会放大错误证据和延迟。

interpretation.businessProblem: 广告排序想引入更大模型理解用户意图和广告价值，但广告请求要求亚秒级返回，且算力成本必须被 ROAS 覆盖。

interpretation.borrowable: 广告团队可先把“请求价值分层 + 模型复杂度路由”用于高商业价值流量，低价值请求继续走轻模型，逐步验证边际 ROI。

items.title: Enhancing Ad Relevance: Integrating Real-Time Context into Sequential Recommender Models
items.summary: Pinterest 将实时浏览上下文接入广告序列召回，通过 synthetic context 训练和离线/在线混合用户 embedding 推理，在 Related Pins 场景提升 Recall@K、候选相关性和广告 relevance。

interpretation.businessProblem: Pinterest Related Pins 广告既要利用用户长期 offsite 转化序列，又要响应当前浏览 Pin 的实时语义；只用静态用户 embedding 会错过会话意图。
interpretation.systemMechanism: 在 Transformer 用户塔之外增加 context layer，将当前 Pin 的兴趣类别 embedding、置信权重和用户人口统计特征拼接进最终 MLP；训练时用正样本构造 synthetic context，serving 时采用离线序列 embedding + 在线 context head 的混合推理。
interpretation.metricsAndExperiment: 离线用 Recall@K 衡量正样本进入 topK 的能力，线上看 candidate survival、relevance、广告相关性、delivery 和业务指标；文章报告 Recall@K 提升 3x-10x，候选相关性中位数提升约 275%-300%，Related Pins ads relevance 提升 1.08%。
interpretation.borrowable: 广告召回可把“长期用户序列”和“实时上下文”拆成离线/在线两段推理，既控制延迟又让当前页面语义影响召回 embedding。
interpretation.boundary: 当实时上下文质量不稳、训练无法构造可信 synthetic context，或在线 head 延迟预算太紧时，这种混合推理会引入线上线下偏差。

items.title: Why We Use Separate Tech Stacks for Personalization and Experimentation
items.summary: Spotify 解释为什么把个性化 ML 栈和实验平台分离：ML 栈负责低延迟推荐决策，实验栈负责评估、rollout 和跨团队治理，避免 contextual bandit 被误用成万能平台。

interpretation.businessProblem: 个性化推荐和实验平台都处理用户差异，但目标不同：前者要实时做个体决策，后者要可靠判断策略是否带来长期收益；混成一套系统会让特征、延迟、指标窗口和治理互相牵制。
interpretation.systemMechanism: Spotify 让 ML/AI 栈承载推荐模型、特征和低延迟 serving，把 contextual bandit 等个性化策略作为实验 variant 接入 Confidence 实验平台，由实验栈负责随机化、rollout、统计评估和多团队并行。
interpretation.metricsAndExperiment: 核心看长期留存、收听行为、首页实验吞吐、模型迭代速度、实验配置错误、低延迟特征稳定性；文中给出移动首页一年 58 个团队运行 520 个实验的治理量级。
interpretation.borrowable: 中大型推荐团队应把“模型服务”和“实验判定”拆成两个 owner 清晰的系统；bandit 可以是策略，不应替代实验平台、特征平台和长期指标观测。
interpretation.boundary: 早期产品样本少、指标窗口短或没有实验文化时，完整双栈会显得重；但至少要避免把线上自适应流量分配误当成长期因果结论。

items.title: How we optimized Dash's relevance judge with DSPy
items.summary: Dropbox Dash 用 DSPy 将 relevance judge 从手写 prompt 调参变成可度量优化循环，在 query-document 相关性评分上降低 NMSE，并显著减少结构化输出失败。

interpretation.businessProblem: 企业搜索需要大量 query-document 相关性标签来训练排序模型，但人工标注成本高，LLM judge 又容易贵、漂移和输出格式不稳定。
interpretation.systemMechanism: 把 relevance judge 固定为 1-5 分 JSON 输出任务，使用带解释的人类标注样本和 NMSE 作为目标，再用 DSPy/GEPA 自动搜索 prompt，使低成本模型贴近人工评分并保持可解析输出。
interpretation.metricsAndExperiment: 指标包括 NMSE、人类一致性、有效 JSON 比例、模型成本、批处理失败率和迁移到小模型后的回归；文章报告 o3 到 gpt-oss-120b 适配 NMSE 降低 45%，gemma-3-12b malformed JSON 下降超过 97%。
interpretation.borrowable: 搜索/推荐团队可把 LLM judge 当作可优化的生产组件：固定任务 schema、准备人工金标、把输出合法性纳入损失，而不是只做主观 prompt review。
interpretation.boundary: LLM judge 不能替代最终线上 A/B；敏感数据、权限文档、长尾 query 和跨语言语义仍需人工抽检与漂移监控。

items.title: SABER-Math: Automated Benchmark for Information Retrieval Evaluation in Mathematics
items.summary: As agentic AI systems tackle more complex mathematical tasks, they increasingly rely on information retrieval (IR) to search problem databases, theorem libraries, and educational resources. However, choosing the right retriever remains difficult, as it is infeasible to directly isolate its effect on downstream performance. On the other hand, existing retrieval-specific benchmarks often fail to capture fine-grained mathematical relevance, penalizing relevant documents. We address this gap by introducing SABER-Math, the first fully automated benchmark for evaluating mathematical IR without expert annotation. Starting from 283K high-school-level math problems with solutions, SABER-Math builds challenging reranking tasks in three steps: (i) first, LLMs extract concise solution summaries and mathematical topics for each problem; (ii) then, per-query relevant documents are discovered using ontology topic-based and lexical solutions-summary-based similarities, and (iii) finally, a Swiss-style LLM preference tournament produces fine-grained relevance ratings for the documents. We evaluate lexical retrievers, specialized mathematical retrieval systems, and recent embedding models. We find that while modern embedding models substantially outperform classical and math-specific baselines, even the strongest systems struggle in symbol-heavy domains like Algebra and Calculus. Importantly, we show that general-purpose IR benchmarks such as MTEB do not reliably predict mathematical performance, especially for recent embedding models, highlighting the need for math-specific retrieval benchmarks.

items.title: Fast and Feasible: Permutation-based Constrained Reranking for Revenue Maximization
items.summary: Search and recommender systems have produced highly relevant search results. A natural next step in the development of such systems in e-commerce is to rerank these results to increase the platform's revenue from paid promotion products. However, maximizing revenue alone may degrade the user experience by reducing relevance or increasing fraud risk. To avoid this, we state the reranking problem as an integer linear program ($ILP$) that maximizes revenue subject to per-query constraints on other metrics, e.g., relevance. Since solving $ILP$ exactly for every query is slow for deployment to the online service, we propose a lightweight permutation-based reranking approximation algorithm PermR. At each step, the algorithm selects a pair of neighboring items and swaps them to either improve the objective or repair a violated constraint. We evaluate PermR across multiple categories of a large classified platform in offline and online settings. PermR achieves about 63\% of the ILP revenue improvement, within production latency limits, preserving all constraints. In a 14-day online A/B test over 56 million search queries, PermR increased revenue by $2$\%.

items.title: Planning over Matrix-Factorization MDPs for Candidate Generation
items.summary: For a recommender service, we view the customer journey as a chain of item recommendations: a useful item changes the user's state and therefore what should be retrieved next. Standard matrix-factorization retrieval ignores this -- it builds one user vector and returns the top-$K$ items by a static score, treating them as independent. We ask a narrow question: when is it worth planning over the user-state dynamics that fold-in induces? To answer it we propose casting top-$K$ retrieval as an MDP over the implicit-ALS posterior $(A^{-1},u)$, where an action is an item and the transition is a closed-form rank-one fold-in, and the trajectory reward combines a relevance similarity with a posterior-alignment term. Under the same fixed embeddings we compare static retrieval, one-step planning, and horizon-$K$ MCTS across five datasets and two protocols: a per-user leave-last-$n$ split and a stricter global time split. Dynamics-aware planning tends to overcome static retrieval on all datasets under leave-last-$n$, and the gains hold on MovieLens-1M and the VK-LSVD slices under the global time split. A single step of lookahead already captures most of the gain, so the lightweight planning layer turns static top-$K$ scoring into a short decision and improves retrieval over fixed collaborative-filtering embeddings, with no retraining and no change to the representation. These gains depend on measuring relevance with cosine rather than inner-product similarity, which is otherwise entangled with item popularity.
